projects.name: Agent2Agent Protocol
projects.description: Protocol for agent authentication, skills advertisement via AgentCards, direct messaging, and task-lifecycle orchestration across agents. Open-source, under active development.

_github.description: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol enabling communication and interoperability between opaque agentic applications.

projects.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
projects.description: Open standard for connecting buyers, their AI agents, and businesses to complete purchases. Defines checkout flow, payment credential sharing, and extensions. Jointly maintained by OpenAI and Stripe.

_github.description: The Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) is an interaction model and open standard for connecting buyers, their AI agents, and businesses to complete purchases seamlessly. The specification is currently maintained by OpenAI and Stripe.

projects.name: Agent Governance Toolkit
projects.description: Seven-package system for runtime security governance of AI agents. Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity with Ed25519, execution sandboxing, and SRE patterns. Framework-agnostic adapters.

_github.description: AI Agent Governance Toolkit — Policy enforcement, zero-trust identity, execution sandboxing, and reliability engineering for autonomous AI agents. Covers 10/10 OWASP Agentic Top 10.

projects.name: AgentID
projects.description: Cryptographic identity system for AI agents with DID-based identification, challenge-response verification, and a shared interop repo hosting crosswalk fixtures with adjacent protocols.

_github.description: Joint interop test vectors: AgentID identity + APS authorization + governance receipts

projects.name: AgentKit
projects.description: Developer toolkit that lets AI agents carry cryptographic proof they are backed by a unique human via World ID delegation. Integrates with x402 for micropayments and UCP for agentic commerce.

projects.name: Agent Identity Protocol
projects.description: Verifiable delegation protocol for AI agent systems. Introduces Invocation-Bound Capability Tokens with compact (JWT) and chained (Biscuit with Datalog) wire formats, with Python and Rust reference implementations.

projects.name: APort
projects.description: Passport-based authorization for AI agents. Attaches verifiable permissions to agent identities, with a pre-action authorization and suspension model. Integrates with major agent frameworks.

projects.name: Agent Passport System
projects.description: Cryptographic identity, scoped delegation, governance, and commerce protocol for AI agents. Ed25519 signatures, offline-verifiable, 26 v2 constitutional modules across identity, delegation, enforcement, data lifecycle, accountability, and coordination. Reference implementations in TypeScript and Python with cross-language byte-parity verified across the full Wave 1 surface.

_github.description: Cryptographic identity, delegation, governance, and commerce protocol for AI agents. Ed25519 signatures, 107 protocol modules, 2966 tests. npm install agent-passport-system

projects.name: Delegated Agent Authorization Protocol
projects.description: Open, model-neutral protocol for cryptographic agent identity using DIDs, a human-consent grant flow modelled on OAuth 2.0, signed JWT grant tokens, and a policy engine with OPA and Cedar integration.

relates_to.note: Independent convergence on delegation invariants; external policy engine binding.

projects.name: ERC-8004 Trustless Agents
projects.description: Ethereum standard extending the Agent-to-Agent protocol with three lightweight on-chain registries for agent identity, reputation, and validation. Mainnet-live since January 2026.

relates_to.note: Blockchain-based trust layer on top of A2A.

_github.description: Registry contracts curated by the 8004 team

projects.name: Human Delegation Provenance
projects.description: Lightweight cryptographic protocol for human delegation provenance in agentic AI. Token-based scheme with append-only hop chain, fully offline verification using only the issuer's Ed25519 public key and session identifier.

relates_to.note: Closest technical cousin on offline-verifiable signed delegation chains.

_github.description: Human Delegation Provenance Protocol - cryptographic chain-of-custody for agentic AI

projects.name: Model Context Protocol
projects.description: Open standard for connecting AI assistants to data sources and tools. Servers expose prompts, resources, tools, and completions over a stable interface consumable by any compatible client.

projects.name: MolTrust
projects.description: Agent trust bridging layer with DID resolution across identity schemes and a cross-chain attestation bridge to Base L2. Operated by CryptoKRI GmbH.

projects.name: Open Agent Trust Registry
projects.description: Open registry for trusted agent issuers. Provides registration, compilation, and a CLI tooling layer for publishing agent trust information and behavioral history references.

_github.description: The open root-of-trust for agent identity on the internet.  A public, federated registry of trusted attestation issuers — the agent runtimes authorized to vouch for agents acting on behalf of humans. Services verify agent attestations against this registry to determine if the issuing runtime is legitimate.

projects.name: SINT Protocol
projects.description: Policy Bundle Specification for layered enforcement contexts across agent identity protocols. Provides a unified handshake profile integrating APS, AIP, and MCP into a single enforcement layer.

_github.description: Open-source runtime security and governance for AI agents, MCP tools, robotics, industrial automation, and physical AI.

projects.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
projects.description: Open-source standard for agentic commerce across consumer surfaces, businesses, and payment providers. Developed by Google with Shopify, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart, and 20+ endorsers.

projects.name: x402
projects.description: Open protocol for agentic micropayments embedded in the HTTP layer. Enables AI agents and software to pay each other in stablecoins without human intervention at each step. Co-developed by Coinbase and Cloudflare.

_github.description: A payments protocol for the internet. Built on HTTP.

projects.name: ZeroID
projects.description: Autonomous Agent Identity Management System built on OAuth 2.1, WIMSE/SPIFFE, and RFC 8693 token exchange. Delegation with automatic scope attenuation, on-behalf-of chains, and cascade revocation.

_github.description: ZeroID: Autonomous Agent Identity Management System (AAIMS)
